xattr_mount_opts.description: List of mount options recommended to enable extended attributes support for user attributes (e.g., user_xattr for ext2/ext3/ext4, no default for XFS/Btrfs).

max_attr_name_len.description: Maximum length (in bytes) of an attribute name, as imposed by the VFS. Not configurable.

max_attr_value_len.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of an attribute value, as imposed by the VFS. Not configurable.

max_listxattr_result_len.description: Maximum total size (in bytes) of the list returned by listxattr(2). Not configurable.

fs_limits.description: List of filesystem-specific extended attribute limits (for documentation). Each item is a dict with keys: fs, max_total_bytes_per_file. Ordered as flat object fields per item below.
